title: GIG-3626: Update Ngramx CLI To Tidy Up Skills And AGENTS.md
description: Stops dumping generated agent instructions into AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md. Writes a short skill index under .cursor and .claude and gitignores only those generated files.

test_plan.description: Generated agent files stay out of git and can be regenerated
steps: Run php bin/ngramx sync-agents twice and confirm the second run reports that targets are already up to date
Confirm AGENTS.md has no NGRAMX_AGENTS_MANAGED markers and that .cursor/skills/ngramx-start-ticket is gitignored
